Package hadur117.sepia

Class SepiaBrain

java.lang.Object
hadur117.sepia.SepiaBrain
public final class SepiaBrain extends Object
Sepia's brain for one battle: reads the enemy's shots, fixes a landing for each with the Gait, lays ink across those landings with the InkPlanner, and punches with the PunchGun when a punch is worth more (STRIKE-1).

It never imports Robocode: the adapter, hadur117.Sepia, turns engine events into the calls below and the SepiaBrain.Orders back into setters. Each tick the adapter reports the tick's events first, then the enemy's scan if there was one, then calls tick(long, double, double, double, double, double, double, double, double).

    • inkWorthMore

      boolean inkWorthMore(InkPlanner.Shot ink, double power, double energy)
      STRIKE-1 and STRIKE-3: the ink against a punch of power, per tick of reload. The ink is worth the damage and energy return of the bullets it is expected to stop; the punch its hit chance times its damage and return, less what it costs. With no wave in flight, or the enemy too weak to fire again while Sepia leads, the punch is taken.

    • exposure

      double exposure(InkWave w, Gait.Forecast f)
      JET-2, SURF-4: a landing's exposure. Its chance of holding the bullet, times the damage, times the share of it left unshaded by our bullets in the air and by the next ink the planner could lay from where the option puts Sepia when the gun is next cool. A landing near the enemy or a wall costs more.
